description: Restoration-membrane governance contract. Each rule enforces one PROCEDURE.md law. Agnostic data; the per-agent adapter compiles it to a harness hook surface. Default mode is advisory: fires are logged and nudged, nothing is blocked, until the fire-log shows the paved path holds.

rules.name: no-shell-out
rules.message: The codex-membrane is live as registered MCP tools — call list_documents / get_summary / get_slice / propose_edit / apply. Don't launch mcp-server.ps1 or dot-source src/*.ps1 from a shell; that bypasses leasing, anti-clobber, and the ledger.

rules.name: no-slurp
rules.message: Don't load whole documents. Use get_summary for bearings, get_hotspots/search for the work-list, then get_slice for the one unit you were pointed to. Content comes only where content is the point.

rules.name: no-regenerate
rules.message: Artifacts are ground truth, mutated only via propose_edit -> apply (or the structural ops). Don't hand-edit the chunk stream; send the diff through the membrane so it grades and audits.

rules.name: finish-clean
rules.message: Before finishing: confirm finalize + review_document ran for each worked paper and that pending == 0. Flagged chunks still open mean the deliverable is provisional.
rules.note: Genuinely semantic (type=agent). The reference command-adapter can only emit this as an advisory reminder on Stop; a deterministic check (resolve the papers touched this session, query each summary's pending count) is future work, ideally an agent-type hook.
